descriptionEn:
서연이 and 혜린이 were the first pair revealed while living at 가평 HAUS,

and the cute chemistry name was given because they were the two shorter members before the other taller S members were revealed.

Because they are tripleS’s only Queendom Puzzle (survival) alumni, fans called them Queendomz, but
while hosting 240902 IDOL RADIO MC they referred to each other as 계란즈.
When asked why 계란즈, on 230614 SIGNAL LIVE
서연이 wore yellow and 지우 wore white, so they say they settled on 계란즈 that day.
(Looking back at 230614 SIGNAL LIVE, they tried to decide a chemistry name together but didn’t finish and
brushed past it vaguely, yet both seem to remember it as 계란즈)

The chemistry name came because both are puppy-like members.
From a puppy’s whimper sound, 김채연 is 뭉뭉,
and it means 윤서연 is 망망 and looks like she’s about to cry.



The chemistry name was decided through a WAV fan vote

On 220901 SIGNAL LIVE, chemistry name candidates like ‘뽀얀즈, 토끼즈’ and so on were mentioned, and 서연이 said she wanted to be a rabbit too, so because both have fair skin and are rabbits they combined the two and agreed on ‘뽀토즈’.

As 뽀토즈 came about, it naturally became the chemistry name 뽀냥즈 with cat-like 김나경.
On 241226 SIGNAL LIVE they mentioned it directly and it became their chemistry name.

As the third spin-off chemistry name from 뽀토즈, 밤 is taken from 유빈이’s nickname 유밤이,
and 뽀 can be ‘뽀’ as in fair-skinned or ‘뽀’ as in Pochacco.
Fans gave this chemistry name because 서연이 and 카에데’s faces look soft and round like 물떡.

햄햄다즈 is a cute chemistry name made by pairing 서연이’s nickname ‘햄햄’ with 다현이’s ‘다’, likening it to 하겐다즈 ice cream. 열일즈 combines 다현’s member number S10 read in a Koreanized way as ‘열’ and 서연이’s member number S1 read as ‘일’; it’s also short for ‘열심히 일을 한다’. Because both work hard, 서연이 really liked it, and on 250909 SIGNAL LIVE they agreed to use both 햄햄다즈 and 열일즈. Fans seem to use 햄햄다즈 more, though.

Because 서연이 and 코토네’s reveal numbers are only 1s— S1 and S11—the 1 looked like a Pepero stick, so it became 빼빼로즈.

It became known through 240117 코토네 fromm

The chemistry name combines hamster 햄, the animal 서연이 resembles, and puppy (니엔’s animal look, woof-woof). However, international WAVs use Sunnyz more than 햄멍즈.

On 250330 fromm—with 서연—settled it.
Even when WAV asked how the two got close, 서연이 said 소현이 and she were each other’s biases, so they became close quickly. It’s a chemistry name that came about because they were each other’s favorites.
Because 윤서연 and 저우신위 share the same initial consonants ‘ㅇㅅㅇ’, they set the chemistry name on 230913 SIGNAL LIVE

서연이 and 시온이 are both from Daejeon and love bread; the chemistry name shortens ‘빵을 냠냠먹다’ (munching on bread).

They set it on 240126 SIGNAL LIVE.
On 250210 SIGNAL they made this chemistry name and unit name, 자몽 샤베트. They’re said to be a two-person YouTuber(?) made up of 천연기념물 1호 리유저블 비닐 팩 (윤서연) and 갈리다만 선녀 (김채원).
In tripleS the two are S1 and S24, and their real names are 윤서연 and 지서연, matching—so their chemistry name became 서연즈.

On 220726 SIGNAL, 혜린이 and 유연이 took Japanese lessons together; 유연이 misheard ‘you worked hard’ as ‘sugoi’ and afterward answered everything with sugoi, and from the day of that lesson the two became 스고이즈.
On 250929 COSMO voice-only live, 혜린이 forgot 스고이즈 existed and it looks like they’ll pick a new chemistry name; leading candidates are (25즈 and 심장이 유혜).
photo by. @triplesbburing
혜린이 and 수민이 are both from the same region, born in Daegu, so they’re called 대구즈.
혜린이 and 유빈이 were roommates during Namsan HAUS; then, saying both had big eyes, they made the chemistry name ‘왕눈즈’.

When rendering 카에데’s name in Korean, the ‘단’ from maple (단풍) and the ‘네’ from 혜린이’s nickname 리네 are changed to 내, making a pun-like Korean dialect phrase 단내 난다 meaning ‘a sweet scent is in the air’. 250811 SIGNAL—혜린이 chose this chemistry name herself.
At a neighborhood playground a little kid saw 혜린이 and 다현이 and called them aunties—they told that story on 230405 SIGNAL LIVE, and that’s when it was coined.
250317 official SNS: 혜린이 posted a selca with 코토네 and used it. 혜린’s nickname 리네’s ‘네’ and 코토네’s ‘네’ are thought to be where the chemistry name comes from.

A chemistry name combining 소현’s ‘소’ and 혜린이’s nickname 리네’s ‘리’,


made on 231117 박소현’s fromm.

On 250210 SIGNAL, 자몽 샤베트 gave them this chemistry name.

혜린이 and 신위 said they often shop together and their tastes match well.

Set on 260412 SIGNAL LIVE, 혜린이 and 린’s birthday SIGNAL LIVE; shark in Japanese is 샤메, whose ‘샤’ combines with the ‘냥’ from 고양이를 귀엽게 부르는 냥냥이 (cutesy cat noises) to make the chemistry name. They say the sharp vibe of ‘웨이브를 사냥하겠다’ feels good. (Temporary chemistry name)
정혜린 and 정하연 are the same age; before 서아 (정해린)’s reveal they were the only Jung members in the team, which is why the chemistry name was coined. 240123 SIGNAL LIVE made it official.
While living at Gapyeong HAUS they shared the mint room and became roommates—that’s how they got close—and afterward they were also called 민트방즈.
Through appearing on 방과후 설렘, they already knew each other before joining the group; on the program’s 세미파이널 무대 they met as rivals and performed ‘Leon’ together.
On 220819 SIGNAL, 수민이 misspeaking ‘destiny’ to 유연이 created ‘데니스트’, combined with the ‘Death Note’ necklace 지우 wanted in New York but never bought, to settle on ‘데니즈’.

Before Modhaus they trained as actors together at JYP; on 220701 SIGNAL, to 이지우’s question ‘Do you have a friend who could be a new S?’ they answered ‘yes’, and later revealed the person they thought of was 공유빈. It’s one of the most famous chemistries in tripleS.

Through 260322 코토네 fromm, it means 쥬 (지우) and 또네 (토네),
and they said they chose it because it’s a bit like the Japanese ずっと (zutto).

Mixing their signature colors makes 연두 (light green), and both have that fresh 연두 vibe.
12 (연지) 3 (지우) — the numbers 123 carry the meaning of two members ‘연’-connected as ‘두’.
　
The chemistry name was decided through a WAV fan vote.
지우’s ‘우’ combines with 마유’s ‘유’ to form the chemistry name. They made it on 240320 SIGNAL LIVE.

On 250511 지연 fromm they were talking; saying ‘secret,’ 지크릿, and a WAV mentioned ‘chiring-chiring-chiring Secret Juju’.
So 지연이 liked it, told 지우, and it became the chemistry name 지크릿쥬쥬즈.

The chemistry came because both are said to have peach-like faces. 김채연’s representative emoji was also a peach.
[As of ’25 채연이 came to dislike peaches and switched to a deer emoji.]
김채연 looks like My Melody and 김나경 looks like Kuromi, so their chemistry name became 마멜즈.

채연이 and 유빈이 host
드림센터 스터디룸 as its MC on 올더케이팝, which gave them this chemistry name.

In the past, at a Disney princess fan sign 김채연 and 카에데 went as Elsa and Anna respectively; they say oo즈는 식상하니 프로즌 felt right instead of another oo-z name.
photo by. annyeongsubsubs
From 보니하니, which 채연이 used to host, merged with 코토네’s name; 코토네 reportedly got candidates through fromm and confirmed with 채연이.
Combines 김채연’s ‘연’ and 니엔’s ‘엔’; it’s also a pun on ‘celebrity’ (연예인).
채연’s ‘연’ and 마유’s ‘유’ combine into this chemistry name.

On 251224 COSMO LIVE they said foreheads showing look prettier than covered bangs and started calling each other 이마즈.
Originally on 241031 SIGNAL LIVE they used 비스니즈 because things felt awkward and ‘business,’ but within a year they grew much closer and seem to have made a new chemistry name.

During Girls Never Die promos, in The Show waiting room 하연이 pretended to kiss 채연이, and because 채연 didn’t dodge, they accidentally kissed once.
On 240716 SIGNAL LIVE, 하연 recalled closing her eyes to mime a kiss and being surprised it felt 촉촉 (moist), and suggested the chemistry name 촉촉즈.
The original pair name was ‘김채즈’ because both names include 김채, but the two said they’re matcha mates and changed it to 말차즈 themselves. Mentioned on 250621 SIGNAL.

Set on 240814 SIGNAL LIVE  
채연’s ‘연’ joins with the ‘락’ from 설린’s Thai birth name 피라다 분락사 to make the chemistry name.
유연 and 수민 both love strawberry lattes, which gave them this chemistry name.

The pair of February-born 김유연 and October-born 김나경 likewise used the chemistry name 투텐즈
when the two served together as special DJs for IDOL RADIO at 241028 아이돌 라이브.
유연이 and 유빈이 both have “유” in their names, which became the combination name..

In the Hit the Floor choreography, there is a section right after the second-verse chorus where 김유연 and 카에데 are both off to the left side of the stage,
and when performing that stage at fansigns, the two always hug during this part while saying “나안아~,” which gave rise to the chemistry name.
Later, 김유연 made the chemistry name official through fromm.
Photo by @Sharon_0209

유연이 and 토네 needed a new chemistry name, but every time they tried to decide,
they kept putting off choosing one 250418 코토네 fromm
fans suggested 미룬즈.After checking with 유연이, she said it was good, so it became official.


photo by. @yume040310
Based on first impressions, 박소현 looked cold and 김유연 looked warm, so the chemistry name 냉온즈 was coined.

In a Girls Never Die music video behind-the-scenes clip, wearing the same outfits and similar hairstyles,
they said they looked like twins, and the subtitles showed the chemistry name 쌍둥이즈.
유연 and 마유 are tripleS’s representative “rabbit” visuals— 유연이 is the big rabbit and 마유 is the small rabbit—so they are called 토끼즈; some fans also use 마유연.

tripleS’s oldest (유연) and maknae (서아) became 맏막즈.
(For 맏막즈, the maknae-position member changed 연지 -> 주빈-> 서아, three times total.)
Photo by. @s23_Seah
A chemistry name WAV decided on: both look soft and squishy, so it stuck.

Seongsu HAUS era, 수민이 and 카에데 were on live when WAV asked what chemistry name they wanted, and 수민이 said before the live,
she’d eaten gamjatang that day, so they’d go with 감자탕즈—becoming 감자탕즈.
(221129 SINAL LIVE ref.)
A chemistry name using 김수민’s “수” and 서다현’s “다,” and because both talk a lot, it was decided on SIGNAL LIVE.

At the 251129 하찌 event, WAV asked 수민이 for the pair’s chemistry name, and 수민이 answered 타코야끼즈.
Because both have round faces; asked whether they each had an assigned part, 코토네 said she’s the 타코야끼 and 수민 is the 즈 part.
photo by. Kotoworld0310
수민이 and 연지 said that when the two get together it’s 레전드, so they’re picking 레전드 as the chemistry name—mentioned on 수민이 fromm.

On 240807 주빈이 fromm, asked whether she had a chemistry name with 수민이, she mentioned 잭과콩나뭉즈; 수민이 is “잭” and 주빈이 is “콩나뭉,” and they say they don’t know why it’s “뭉.” 수민이 set it herself, but a year later 수민이 forgot and only 주빈이 remembers—a one-sided crush chemistry name(?) You can confirm on 250913 주빈이 fromm.
Photo by. DoNot_S6

A chemistry name made by combining “왹,” a shortened form of 채원이’s nickname 외계인, with “숨,” a shortened form of 수민이.
At first it was a name fans used among themselves, but now many fans and members use it; it’s effectively settled and treated like an official chemistry name.

On 230316 SIGNAL, seeing the two assigned to the comparatively small-headcount Yeouido HAUS,
유연 joked whether 나경이 and 유빈이 were being quarantined,
and afterward everyone except the two themselves—members and fans alike—started calling them 격리즈.

A chemistry name using 김나경’s “나” and 서다현’s “다.”
The two had the Lotte Giants ceremonial first pitch and catch canceled right in front of them twice. (rain cancellation, heat-wave cancellation),
but as the Lotte Giants victory fairies on 250816, they finally pulled off the pitch and catch.
A chemistry name made by combining 나(낫)경 and 코토네. Revealed via 코토네 fromm.

Originating from 가수 비비님’s song 밤양갱—나경이’s older sister—the chemistry name was born.나경이’s symbol, the cat, and 니엔’s symbol, the dog, were combined to make this chemistry name.

밤양갱 + cat “냥” from 고냥이 + “갱” from 갱얼쥐

The two also used the chemistry name 밤냥갱즈 when serving as special DJs on 240904 IDOL RADIO..

They share the same birth year, month, and day.
On 241226 SIGNAL LIVE, the chemistry name came from both being prone to forgetting things.
To dress it up, they said it was 깜 from 깜냥이’s “깜” and 박쌤’s “박.”
A chemistry name combining “키” from 나경’s nickname 나키 and “위” from 신위.

Because 김나경’s S number is 7 and 린’s S number is 17, the chemistry name 칠칠즈 was formed.
photo by. april_s17

First mentioned on 하연이’s fromm, they said they often happened to overlap in unexpected situations, shouting “we’re 필연!”
—and that’s how the chemistry name came about.

A chemistry name combining 나경’s nickname “나키” and 지연’s “지.” It was mentioned on 250124 나경 fromm, and
it closed with “I’ll ask 지연이,” but at the 260208 fansign, 지연이 brought it up, making it an official chemistry pairing.
photo by. wavv57

Interpreting 카에데’s name in Korean style as 단풍, it’s a chemistry name combining 단풍’s “단” with “밤” from 유빈’s nickname 유밤.
photo by.OvO_ple

Baby tiger 유빈이 and baby wolf-cat 연지 mean they’re both baby beasts that go “캬옹.”
WAV 팬투표 decided the chemistry name
photo by. Compexity_12
Through 240229 유빈 fromm, a fan asked what her chemistry name with 주빈이 was; 주빈이 said 공주즈 sounded good, so that’s what was chosen. photo by. Bin_C1ndy_u
A chemistry name decided on 250612 SIGNAL LIVE, taking one syllable each from 공유빈’s “공” and 정하연’s “연.” They said it was a temporary chemistry name, but it now seems to be used officially.
Combines 설린’s “설” and “밤” from 유빈이’s nickname 유밤. At the 250813 콘서트 비하인드, 유빈이 mentioned it directly, and later mentioned it again through 유빈 fromm.

유빈이 and 지연이 mentioned that whether something good or bad happens, they experience it together the same way every time, and even when splitting into groups they keep ending up together—
shortening “one plus one,” they became 원플원즈.

카에데 and 다현 were roommates for about five months in Seongsu HAUS’s 블루방, forming a very close bond.
You can see there’s a chemistry compilation on 230823 SIGNAL.

It was officially attached as “카토네,” but on 230412 SIGNAL LIVE, unhappy with the name 카토네, they took one “ㅋ” from each name and made “ㅋㅋ즈.”
On 240909 코토네 fromm, complaining that the company calls them 카토네,
they clearly reiterated once again that the chemistry name is “ㅋㅋ즈.”
A WAV went to a fansign and wrote on the post-it asking 연지 what chemistry name she wanted with 카에데, recording that they wanted to do 동글즈.
Made from 니엔’s “니” and 카에데’s “카”; mixed to fit their nationalities with Chinese (你) and Japanese (可愛い).

Combines 소현’s “소” and “풍” from the meaning of 카에데’s name, 단풍.

Photo by. kaede_noway

A chemistry name from 마유’s “마” and 카에데’s “카,” created on 230726 SIGNAL LIVE.
photo by. manimanihus_o0
In Badge War Season 2, a chemistry name made by taking “냐” from 카에데’s one-person line “안 봤냐?” and from 박시온’s famous line “날겠냐?”; it was set on 250218 SIGNAL LIVE.

Because 다현이 and 코토네 each named their individual fan units “소다단” and “콜라단,” 코토네 coined this chemistry name.
photo by. lovewav
Combines 서다현’s signature nickname “소다” with 박소현’s name “소현.”

On 240916 추석 SIGNAL, taking the team name “야무지” with 설린, they almost chose the chemistry name “무지즈,”
but worried it sounded too “무지,” so on 241025 SIGNAL LIVE they went with the opposite meaning, “지능즈.”

An official pairing of 메인보컬; 다현 and 시온 both took main vocal in their first activity after debut, which led to the name.
photo by. Tiramisu0403
A chemistry name combining 김채원’s symbol emoji “딸기” with 서다현’s nickname “소다,” decided on 240830 SIGNAL LIVE .

Inspired by 다현 어린이 and 설린 어린이; they say the chemistry name comes from both having childlike sides.
On 260119 SIGNAL, 다현이 earnestly insisted everyone must say “닿.”
A chemistry name combining 서아’s “서” with “소” from 다현’s nickname 소다.250423 SIGNAL is where it was finalized.

Named because both lived at Tokyo HAUS.
Challenges 도쿄즈 have done over the years
**2023**,**2024**,**2025**, **2026**.(노래는 Love On Top)

The chemistry name comes from konnichiwa, a Japanese greeting, combining Ko from 코토네 and Ni from 니엔 to make a pair name that feels like a greeting. In the opening part of 230526 SIGNAL, a scene shows them greeting each other with konnichiwa. 니엔 created the chemistry name herself.

박소현 was hosting 230515 SIGNAL LIVE alone when 코토네 appeared as a guest, and they ran the live together.
The chemistry name was coined because both members have low voices—literally 토네 and 소현.

코토네 and 마유 often drank Gong Cha together, but when 마유 “graduated” from Gong Cha they could not form 공차즈 and broke up; however,
they still drink bubble tea often, and because they like tapioca—the main ingredient in bubble tea—they settled on '타피즈'.
On 260322 코토네 fromm they mentioned this chemistry again; the pair name is said to come from their surnames—'카미모토' and '카와카미'.

Calling themselves dumpling-faced, they made it during 240709 SIGNAL LIVE. 코토네 is 물만두, and 주빈 is 찐만두.

photo by. Kotoworld0310

The chemistry name was decided on 251116 COSMO VOICE LIVE.
시온이, shortened to 숀, was combined with 콜라, one of 코토네's symbols, and they settled on 숀콜라.
photo by. tipleS_S14_fan

코토네's '코' and 채원's '채' were combined to make this chemistry name.
It is said that the chemistry name is '코챌라', not including oo즈.

In the manga Pinggu, 지연이 mimics the voice well, and
코토네 loves 지연이's Pinggu impression so much that they made it their chemistry name.
Just as the first and last syllables of '눕눕' are the same, the two have very similar tastes, so 코토네 takes 눕1, 지연이 눕2.

니엔's '엔' and 연지's '지' were combined to make this chemistry name.
On 260320 SIGNAL, at 소현's suggestion, 소현 and 니엔 chose the chemistry name themselves. photo by. @0108_biscuit
곽연지's '곽' combined with '줍', the shortened nickname for Joobin — that seems to be how this chemistry name was made. 주빈이 first mentioned it in a 260928 COSMO ROOM comment.

It is said to be a chemistry name made by adding the ㄱ from 귀엽다 to the meeting of gooseumdochi '치' 하연이 and '초'월소녀 연지.
(It is not an official chemistry name; it was decided by a poll on a 연지 fan account.)
photo by. YH_S12S19
At the 240803 fan signing, because 연지 and 채원이 had fan-sign items as Vanilla and Chocola from Sugar Sugar Rune, people mentioned 슈가즈, and it became their chemistry name.

Because 연지 and 지연이's member numbers are S12 and S24, December 24 (크리스마스 이브) came to mind, and they were called 이브즈, which became their chemistry name.
They decided it on 250618 SIGNAL LIVE.

On 230425 SIGNAL, 니엔이 chose the chemistry name herself.
박소현's '박' and '쉬' from 니엔's real name 쉬니엔츠 form this chemistry name.

They are the only two members from Greater China in the group. Because they both appeared on Girls Planet 999: Girls' War, they already knew each other, and they even met in Korea without knowing the other would become a little s.

하연's '하' and 니엔's '니' combine to make this chemistry name.
It is mentioned on 250429 촠촠 블소드 퍼포먼스 촬영 비하인드 SIGNAL.
니엔's '니' and 시온's '온', plus the fact that both love bread, were combined to make this chemistry name.240320 SIGNAL is how it was decided.

It was mentioned on 250514 깨어 쇼케이스 비하인드 SIGNAL.
Both wore odango “ddong” buns, so they were called ddong sisters; then, joking about whether they “like ddong” (?), 똥똥즈 came together.
photo by. madebykenny

소현 '소' and 신위'신' were combined to make this chemistry name.
It is one of the most famous chemistries in tripleS.
Inspired by 린 calling 소현 '소쨩,' it is a chemistry name where 린, who resembles Ponyo, plays Ponyo and 소현 plays Sōsuke (소스케), whose name contains '소.'
A pairing of S members surnamed '박'; the chemistry name was inspired by Heungbu-jeon, where a swallow brings '박씨' seeds. photo by. boang_9424

소현's '소' and 설린's '설' were combined to make this chemistry name.
It came up on 251025 소현이 fromm; they said if 설린이 liked it, they would go with it.
설린이 said she liked it too, so they settled on 소설즈.
